audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated/misassigned ability names. Yone's E is repeatedly called 'Spirit Rewind' (whys[3], spikes[0].text, early, mid, wants.you[0]) — the real name is Soul Unbound. wants.foe[0] calls his W 'Mortal Steel' — Mortal Steel is his Q; the W is Spirit Cleave. Spirit Cleave's shield, which is the thing that decides whether your all-in kills, is never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Mortal Steel (Q, 4s, dashes and knocks up at 2 stacks), Spirit Cleave (W, 14s, cone that shields him more per champion hit), Soul Unbound (E, 22/19/16/13/10s, spirit leaves the body and snaps back repeating part of the damage), Fate Sealed (R, 120/100/80s, blinks behind and pulls everyone hit toward him).
audit.corrected: Real names used throughout, Soul Unbound's 22s rank-1 cooldown and its damage-repeat snapback stated, and Spirit Cleave's shield written into dontsFull[0].d.
sources: brief enemyKit Q/W/E/R text and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill, Yone, Yone, Skill, Skill, Yone, Yone; the packet chart and every whys[] string read Yone, Maokai, Maokai, Skill, Skill, Skill, Yone.
audit.why: whys[0] concedes Level 1 outright, whys[1] and whys[2] describe Maokai bullying him at 2-3, and whys[5] calls the first-item stage even and lane-stable. Only 2+ items is Yone's, which fits a 50.0% win rate over 172 games.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Yone, Levels 2-3 Maokai, Levels 4-5 / 6 / First item Skill, 2+ items Yone.

audit.why: Correctly identifies that Level 6 is HIS spike, not yours — Fate Sealed at 120s rank 1 beats a slow-advancing Nature's Grasp — and that two-item crit Yone reclaims the lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid all assert Yone can 'E-cancel' Nature's Grasp — that Soul Unbound dodges your ultimate root.
audit.why: Soul Unbound sends his spirit out and forces it back to the body; nothing in the kit says the body is immune or that the snapback clears a root. This is exactly the kind of claim the kit cannot settle, so I removed the assertion instead of restating it.
audit.corrected: Those three strings now say Fate Sealed out-spikes the slow wall and Soul Unbound repositions him — no cancel claim.

edits.before: Even stretch: you keep landing W-Q but he can E (Spirit Rewind) out of your root, so neither side runs the other down.
edits.after: Even stretch: you keep landing W-Q but Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 and repositions him, so neither runs the other down.

edits.before: His R knockup out-spikes your slow Nature's Grasp wall — he can E-cancel your ult, so the level keeps balanced at best.
edits.after: Fate Sealed pulls everything it hits toward him and out-spikes your slow wall, so hold your root until after his ult.

edits.before: His R knockup is the real spike here, not yours — Nature's Grasp is a slow wall he can E-cancel out of, so save your root for after his ult.
edits.after: Fate Sealed is the real spike here, not yours — Nature's Grasp advances slowly and Soul Unbound repositions him, so root after his ult.

edits.before: Stack his W (Mortal Steel) to the empowered second hit and dash out with E before your root lands
edits.after: Stack Mortal Steel (Q) to its knockup dash and shield with Spirit Cleave before your root lands

edits.before: Level 1 belongs to him — you have one ability and no combo while his Q poke and W cleave already work, so just last-hit and don't get clipped. The lane flips at 2-3: the moment you complete W-Q you can Twisted-Advance onto him as he dashes in, root him, and Bramble-Smash him back before his E (Spirit Rewind) is a factor — Sap Magic heals whatever his W second-hit chunks. Drop a Sapling on the wave so he can't free-farm with W spirit-cleave.
edits.after: Level 1 belongs to him — you have one ability and no combo while Mortal Steel and Spirit Cleave already work, so just last-hit and don't get clipped. The lane flips at 2-3: the moment you complete W-Q you can Twisted-Advance onto him as he dashes in, root him, and Bramble-Smash him back before Soul Unbound is a factor — Sap Magic heals back what Spirit Cleave chunks. Drop a Sapling on the wave so he cannot free-farm the cone.

edits.before: This is the even stretch — you can keep landing W-into-Q on his step-up, but a good Yone holds E (Spirit Rewind) to undo your root and reposition, so don't burn W on a whiff. At 6 respect HIS ult, not yours: his R knockup beats your slow Nature's Grasp wall, which he can E-cancel out of, so save your root and Sapling slow for AFTER he ults. First item and Sap Magic keep you durable enough to win short trades, but stop chasing once he flips out.
edits.after: This is the even stretch — you can keep landing W-into-Q on his step-up, but a good Yone holds Soul Unbound, 22s at rank 1, to reposition out of your root, so don't burn W on a whiff. At 6 respect HIS ult: Fate Sealed pulls everything it hits toward him and beats your slow Nature's Grasp wall, so save your root and Sapling slow for AFTER he ults. First item and Sap Magic keep you durable in short trades, but stop chasing once he flips out.

edits.before: Once W+Q is up you can walk W onto him mid-dash and Bramble-Smash before his E (Spirit Rewind) is even relevant — your best lockdown window all lane.
edits.after: Once W+Q is up you can walk W onto him mid-dash and Bramble-Smash before Soul Unbound is even levelled — your best lockdown window all lane.

edits.before: Land W (Twisted Advance) the instant he dashes in with Q so he is rooted before E-Rewind comes online
edits.after: Land W (Twisted Advance) the instant Mortal Steel dashes him in, before Soul Unbound comes online

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Root in it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 — he snaps back to his body when it ends.

edits.before: That is Yone's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave shields him more per champion hit — burst it, don't poke it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

notes: 'Spirit Rewind' is a fabricated ability name in the same class as the calibration examples — it appeared five times for Yone's E, which is Soul Unbound. Whether Soul Unbound's snapback clears or dodges a root (the page claimed it 'E-cancels' your ultimate) is not answerable from the kit; I removed the claim rather than repeat it. Also unresolved: the old text described a 'W second-hit chunk', which does not match Spirit Cleave as Riot describes it — that reads like Q stack behaviour mislabelled.
